atoms.b: The acronym “LGBTQIA+” serves as a collective term for all people whose sexual or ((gender_identities)) deviate from the ((norm))—in other words, everyone who does not identify as heterosexual or ((cisgender)). Each ((letter)) stands for an identity, while the ((plus_sign)) represents the ((variety)) of other identities that cannot all be listed within the acronym.

atoms.b:
While sex is ((biological)) and gender a ((social)) phenomenon, it is important to understand that neither of them is ((binary)).
Nature is very diverse—there are people whose biological sex is not clearly male or female. These people are called ((intersex)). For example, their ((chromosomes)) may not follow the pattern of XX or XY, but XXY or X0 instead. Or they may have a uterus, but external ((genitalia)) that appears male.

These ((++sexual_and_romantic gender binary)) orientations refer to individuals who experience ((++little_to_no great_amounts_of)) sexual or romantic attraction to other people regardless of their gender.
A ((++sexual_orientation biological_sex derogatory_term)) referring to women who are attracted to ((++other_women all_genders men)).
A term most commonly used for ((++homosexual heterosexual bisexual)) men, i.e. men who are attracted to ((++other_men multiple_genders women)).
An intersex person's ((++biological_sex sexual_orientation gender_identity)) is ((++ambiguous binary obvious)), meaning they are biologically neither male nor female.
